name: Starship Critical Hits
description: Rogue Trader, Table 8-12 (p. 222). Rolled when a shot's degrees of success meet the weapon's Crit Rating: roll 1d5. A Crippled ship instead takes a Critical Hit whenever damage gets past its Armour, and the result is looked up by the amount of damage that exceeded the Armour - which is why this table carries results above 5. Righteous Fury does not apply to shipboard weapons.

results.name: Holed
results.text: The attacker picks one Component he knows of, other than the bridge or the plasma/warp drives. That Component is depressurised.

results.name: Internal Damage
results.text: The attacker picks one Component he knows of, other than the bridge or the plasma/warp drives. That Component is damaged.

results.name: Sensors Damaged
results.text: Until repaired, all shooting tests suffer -30 and every sensory test beyond immediate engagement range automatically fails. The arrays sit outside the hull, so repairs must be made in the void.

results.name: Thrusters Damaged
results.text: Roll [[1d10]]. On 1-7 Manoeuvrability drops by -20. On 8-10 the ship cannot turn at all. Repairable.

results.name: Fire!
results.text: The attacker picks one Component he knows of, other than the bridge or the plasma/warp drives. That Component is on fire and follows the rules for shipboard fires.

results.name: Engines Crippled
results.text: Roll [[1d10]]. On 1-7 Speed is halved. On 8-10 Speed drops to 1. Repairable.

results.name: Surly Techsprites
results.text: Roll [[1d10]] for every Component: on 4 or higher it counts as unpowered and must be repaired individually. Morale takes [[1d5]] damage.

results.name: Decapitation
results.text: Everyone on the bridge must Dodge or take [[2d10]] Explosive damage. On a damage result of 12 or higher the bridge is also depressurised; on 16 or higher it is damaged as well.

results.name: Hull Breach
results.text: The attacker picks [[1d5]] Components he knows of, excluding the bridge. Roll [[1d10]] for each: on 1-7 it is damaged and depressurised, on 8-10 it is destroyed and everyone inside is killed. Crew Population and Morale are both halved instead of taking separate damage.

results.name: Catastrophic Damage
results.text: Roll [[1d10]]. On 1-7 the ship is hulked. On 8-9 the plasma drive explodes. On 10 the warp drive explodes instead - a ship with no warp drive suffers a plasma drive explosion.
